label: L1 (L0: N4 robustness only)

issues.I1: N1 mis-specified: positions are generated by outcomes (duration tied to outcome); rejection reproducible with zero memory
issues.I2: session-matched random control is a hindsight-biased comparator for within-session sequential rules
issues.I3: Judge 2's hour interaction not run after the as-run rejection

generator: memoryless: real session skeleton (first SETUP bar, 15:25 cut), outcome iid from the hour_bin pool of real IS units, duration of the drawn unit (variant: independent draw), empirical within-session gaps
N3: the 7 statistics on 2,000 memoryless streams (tied duration): doubled-tail p of the observed statistic, Holm over 7
N4: primary: within-hour_bin stratified contrasts across sessions (OLS with hour fixed effects weights n_a n_b / (n_a + n_b); partial Spearman on within-hour demeaned ranks); stationary block bootstrap of active sessions (mean block 10, 2,000 draws), doubled-tail p against 0, Holm over 7; 30-min strata as sensitivity; L0 as robustness
decision: memory claimed iff N4 and N3 both reject at Holm 5% on L1 with agreeing signs; one -> inconclusive (not shown); neither -> no session memory shown; branch B rows re-judged on hindsight-free statistics in every case

hour_cells.note: the one data-informed choice; counted as trials

family: 48 cells; nested / CPCV choice with the pre-registered criterion (max pooled diff | kept_share >= 0.20); PBO / SPA / effective trials over 48; DSR n_trials 48; go_no_go as computed and without the control check
control_pct: reported, never used as evidence for or against a sequential rule (I2)
calibration: per cell: observed pooled diff vs the memoryless distribution (percentile, doubled-tail p); within-hour stratified kept-vs-skipped diff with session-block bootstrap CI / p and its memoryless percentile; diagnostics only
n1_demonstration: N1 (2,000 draws) on 100 tied + 100 independent-duration memoryless streams per timeframe, with the k=2/L=none control percentile (2,000 draws); synthetic, no ledger row
